exceptions.scope: Only reached through biscuit-auth's unconditional P256 dependency when the optional token-bench feature is enabled; it is not in the default om-gateway runtime feature set.
exceptions.reason: biscuit-auth 6.0.0 has no P256 feature toggle, so the requested Ed25519-only build cannot exclude this transitive package without replacing or patching Biscuit.
exceptions.remediation: Before expiry, replace or patch the optional Biscuit benchmark dependency, or upgrade to a release that allows P256 to be disabled; rerun cargo audit and remove this exception when clear.
